info.title: Pagehall API
info.description:
The Pagehall API lets scripts and integrations read and change the data of this instance. Every route is versioned under `/api/v1`.

## Create a token

Scripts authenticate with an API token. There are two kinds:

- **Personal tokens** act as your own account. Create one while signed in with `POST /api/v1/account/tokens`.
- **Service account tokens** act as a service account of an organization, which keeps working when people leave. Holders of the "integrations and API" area create service accounts and their tokens.

A token starts with `ph_` and is shown only once, when it is created. Choose its scopes from the permission areas, each with `view` or `manage`, and optionally limit it to one organization. At every request, the token can do only what both its scopes and its owner's current permissions allow. Tokens expire after 90 days unless you choose another date within the configured maximum. Creating and revoking tokens needs a signed-in session; a token cannot manage tokens.

## Your first request

Send the token in the `Authorization` header. Tokens in the query string are never accepted, and a request that carries both a session cookie and a token is rejected.

```sh
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ph_..." https://wiki.example.org/api/v1/organizations/{organizationId}
```

Requests with a token need no cross-site request header.

## Pagination

Lists return one page at a time:

```json
{ "items": [], "nextCursor": "eyJ..." }
```

Pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query parameter to get the next page, until `nextCursor` is `null`. `limit` sets the page size, from 1 to 200, default 50.

## Errors

Errors follow RFC 9457 Problem Details with the media type `application/problem+json`. Branch on `type`; it is stable, for example `urn:pagehall:problem:forbidden`. `code` repeats its last part. Invalid input lists the affected fields in `fields`.

## Rate limits

Each token may send a configurable number of requests per minute, 600 by default. Above that, the API answers `429` with the problem type `urn:pagehall:problem:rateLimited` and a `Retry-After` header with the seconds to wait.
